invariants.rationale: Result is collected using collect(Collectors.toList()), which produces a non-null List.
Each element in result is the representative of a group in the keyedRecords, whose keys are based on records; result cannot be larger than the original records list.
Parallelism is an integer parameter where negative values are rarely expected and may be protected against upstream.
schemaStr is parsed unconditionally with HoodieSchema.parse(schemaStr), so it must not be null.
props is used in DeleteContext.fromRecordSchema without null checks, so it cannot be null.
